# Robert Van Liew, llms.txt
# https://www.robertvanliew.com/

## Who is Robert Van Liew?

Robert Van Liew is a Product Designer and Full-Stack Developer based in New York, NY.
He specializes in interaction design, design systems, and end-to-end product engineering
across financial products and SaaS platforms.

## Key Projects

- **Smart Deductions**. A client-side financial analytics tool for LLC owners and self-employed
  individuals. Parses bank statements locally in the browser (no server storage), auto-categorizes
  transactions against IRS Schedule C categories, and exports TurboTax-ready reports.
  61% auto-categorization rate, under 5s parse time, ~80% user acceptance of AI suggestions.

- **Jersey Club Radio**. A 24/7 live streaming radio platform for the Jersey Club music scene.
  Sole designer and engineer from problem validation to Figma prototyping to production.
  Persistent mini-player, animated waveform, WCAG-accessible design system.

- **DMC DJ Canada '26**. Full brand and commerce platform for a competitive dance event.
  Delivered in 6 days from Figma to production. Lighthouse 94/100, zero revision rounds,
  full Stripe payment integration.

- **Julie Schatz Music**. Two-week rebuild of a NYC wedding musician site at julieschatzmusic.com.
  Editorial visual system, deep SEO and schema build (LocalBusiness, MusicGroup, Events, Reviews, FAQ),
  and a ceremony picker that drafts across pages into the booking form via localStorage.

- **Take Me Back Bingo**. Hip-Hop and R&B music bingo brand running live nights in NY and NJ, at
  takemebackbingo.com. Editorial mixtape identity, a free in-browser 5x5 game, full Event and FAQ
  schema coverage, and a share, inquiry, and newsletter system governed by a single feature flag.

- **The Jersey City Sound**. A permanent static encyclopedia-archive of Jersey City music culture at
  jerseycitysound.com. 248 entries, 247 of them generated by one Python script from a single JSON
  file that also writes the A to Z index, the Legends memorial wing, the sources bibliography, the
  client-side search index, the sitemap, and llms.txt. Cite-or-cut editorial standard, Person and
  MusicGroup schema per entry, no framework and no database.

- **Lily's Secret**. Brand site for a UAE candle maker whose product hides a personal message in the
  wax, at lilysecretcandles.com. An interactive candle the visitor lights to reveal the message,
  a made-to-order builder with no checkout, six languages including full Arabic right-to-left, and
  an order pipeline that delivers to the studio in English whatever language the customer used.

## Skills & Tools

Design: Figma, design systems, motion design, semantic color token systems.
Front-end: Semantic HTML, modern CSS (Grid, Flexbox, custom properties, container queries, :focus-visible, prefers-reduced-motion), React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Vite.
Specialized: PDF.js, Recharts, Formspree, Schema.org / JSON-LD, WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility, Claude and Gemini for design critique, code review, and prototyping.
